'The next time an attack you control wagers this turn, it gets +2{p}.' One PLAY ability: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK add 2, filter [{ATTACK_HAS_KEYWORD, keyword: wager}]. Every link checked against the handlers, not copied:

- Handler (effect_types.py ~4592-4618) reads mod/amount/filter/scope and queues a one-shot entry on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods. It never reads 'target'/'player' - the controller default is what makes 'you control' hold.
- Consumption (engine._apply_turn_attack_effects, entered at engine.py:542): player = state.active() (engine.py:1015), so the queue is consulted only while THIS player is attacking; filter specs are compiled per incoming attack and evaluated against combat.attack_card. A non-matching attack leaves the entry queued (engine.py:1234-1235 keeps it in 'remaining'), so it waits for the next WAGERING attack rather than burning on any attack - the printed 'next time ... wagers'.
- combat.keywords is seeded with the attack's PRINTED keywords (CombatState built at engine.py:529 with keywords=list(attack_card.keywords)) BEFORE the queue runs (:542), so ATTACK_HAS_KEYWORD (reads combat.keywords, normalises separators - condition_types.py ~1881) sees Wager at declaration time.
- 'This turn': unused entries are cleared at end of turn (engine.py:920-922).
- Data check: 'Wager' is a real printed keyword on attack cards in slug_index (51 cards carry it; attack actions include bet_big_red, drink_em_under_the_table_red), so the filter matches live attacks, not nothing.

Go again is NOT authored: printed_keywords carries GoAgain (unconditional in the text), it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect.

KNOWN APPROXIMATION: an attack that wagers only via ANOTHER card's WAGER effect (no Wager keyword printed on the attack itself) does not match the filter - no DSL condition queries combat.wagers directly. Per CR 8.5.46a an attack is considered to have wagered when its wager effect is generated, so for keyword-wager attacks next-qualifying-attack equals next-wagering-attack; the gap is only the indirect case.

Adoption note: batch lists set MasteryPackWarrior - file under that set's folder at adoption time.
